svg.title: Party wheel — branching skill evolutions
svg.desc: Comparison C. Each skill begins with two tier-one choices. A selected talent reveals three next-tier choices depending on that selection. Exactly one talent is chosen per tier. Unchosen branches remain dim and have no descendants. Strike shows a selected two-tier path and three available tier-three talents, with Aftershock previewed in the right panel. No separate keystones, minor talents, or orbiting gems. Names and effects are illustrative. Static SVG mockup.
svg.text: COMPARISON C / One defining choice per tier. The next rung follows your chosen talent.
exposing the target to your allies.
the rupture spreads to another enemy.
Choosing it closes the other options in this tier.
Any later choices would follow Aftershock.
Only the chosen talent reveals the next rung.
No additional upgrade layer in this version.
STATIC CONCEPT · Names and effects are illustrative.
Icon colour = gem type · Gold highlight = chosen · Dim = not chosen · Bright outline = available · Dotted outline = preview
Skill → 2 options → select one → 3 dependent options → select one → next rung. Hidden branches have no descendants.
